events.summary: Distributed CSP nogood exchange, distributed belief revision and mature MUS/MCS tooling already occupy the candidate's object and guarantees; no implementation justified.

Twelve accredited delegated subjects were mapped; five publish direct early-stage, scanning or public-sector opportunity signals. Internal origination is the main substitute, so the next gate is a traceable three-case blind sample; no outreach occurred.

Token-budgeted truthful disclosure was killed: incentive-compatible information acquisition, truthful distributed optimisation, peer prediction, data-driven VCG and RegretNet already occupy the object. The audit found repeated message-wrapper mutations; next gate is a saturation decision and possible domain pivot.
Blind sample passed 1/3: incumbent route saturation and missing title/savings data falsified the buyer-side radar; pivoted to municipality-side CAE asset recovery.

Final substrate screen killed hash-partitioned search exchange, event-triggered transitions and executable FSM messages; the M2M branch closed as saturated, while the lab remains active for a new automatically judged domain.

Petrer passed the preliminary owner-side gate: official guidance preserves municipal title despite aid/credit, TER180 applies and inventory plus patrimonial disposal is the route; exact savings and owner WTP remain pending.

Three-domain screen admitted budget-aware CI test prioritization; an original judge passed its sanity check. Entity matching failed provenance and fuzzing failed bounded-compute. No public benchmark gain yet.

Petrer winning offer recovered: SICE €1.080.113,35 ex VAT and 98,85 points. The PCAP requires an energy balance and exact powers in the technical annex; TER180, formalized contract and owner WTP remain pending.

FAST was falsified as a budget-aware arena: it lacks per-test durations/APFDc, and repository order lost to random on Chart/Lang/Time (0.491 vs 0.526 macro APFD). Coleman-compatible historical CI datasets replace it; no winner yet.

Guadalajara budgeted €11,475 for CAE analysis, municipal inventory and sale preparation; Badajoz budgeted €12,850 for 45 municipalities/779 MWh. Public procurement validates buyer and price, while sujeto-delegado requirements narrow the offer to owner-side work.

Chronological Deeplearning4j benchmark found a provisional leader: at 50% budget recall was 0.877 vs 0.832 repository order and 0.837 failure-per-second; elapsed-time TTFF was 0.073 vs 0.091 next-best. One project only; cross-project replication pending.

Badajoz 287/25 was officially declared deserted on 10 Jun 2025 with no awardee; Guadalajara remains pending in the accessible listing. Budgeted tenders no longer count as paid WTP. Candidate demoted to ACTIVE/N5 pending three actual awards/executions.

Three-project leakage-safe replication killed recency-weighting as a budget-invariant leader: it lost recall to ordinary failure-per-second on two projects at 25%, but won on two at 50%. A preregistered budget switch is HOLD pending held-out tests and native Coleman.
Held-out IOF/ROL, Paint Control and LexisNexis killed the preregistered budget switch: the joint median recall and TTFF gate failed at 10%, 25% and 50%; no leader remains.

Tordoia formalized a CAE-rights auction with Naturgy Iberia, five bidders and EUR 19,064.97 municipal income; a public case study connects specialist owner-side preparation to the outcome. Alcobendas adds an awarded P1 lead, but strict paid-assistance comparables remain 0/3.
